text: Need a better way to handle masking background distractions with continuous focus soundscapes, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord?
Watch TuneOut2FocusIn in action: Generates acoustic soundscapes locally on your device so a sudden ad, buffering spinner, or airplane mode never interrupts your flow state.

Keeps playing smoothly even when you close the side panel or switch between browser windows—with instant one-click mute and volume control. Plus, switch effortlessly between deep low-frequency brown noise for ADHD focus, balanced gray noise, crisp white noise, and warm rain.
Uses 0 megabytes of internet bandwidth and makes zero network requests—just pure, instant acoustic focus whenever you need it.
Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
